species.real: In one telling, the Lyminster knucker was killed by a farm lad called Jim Pulk, who baked it a poisoned pie.
species.name: Knucker

dex.text: Lives at the bottom of a pool that has no bottom, which it finds very relaxing. Comes up for weather, gossip and pie.
dex.fact: Knucker holes are spring-fed Sussex ponds, said to be bottomless; the name comes from the Old English nicor, a water monster. In Lyminster church a worn gravestone, the Slayer's Slab, is said to belong to the man who killed the knucker with a poisoned pie.
